qa.question: How is JDM different from OEM?
qa.answer: OEM = You provide the design → we manufacture. JDM = We co-develop the product — engineering, design and R&D are shared.

qa.question: Is JDM suitable for startups?
qa.answer: Yes. Startups use JDM to build prototypes, refine designs, reduce cost and scale manufacturing without setting up a factory.
